subject: PII handling confirmation for prompts/outputs - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: PII handling confirmation for prompts/outputs - Acme Health

Hi Sana, thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few specific follow-ups we promised to confirm: 

Summary of ask from Acme Health:
- Your integrations will send prompts that may include patient identifiers (names, MRNs) and limited PHI (visit reason, dates).
- You need assurance on: what prompt/output data Redwood stores, where it is stored (region), how long it is retained, and what logging/audit controls are available.

What we covered on the call:
- Deployment model options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and how those impact data residency and control.
- Controls we have for masking/logging and retention policies.

Follow-ups / questions I need from you to finalize confirmation:
1) Can you confirm the scope of data types you expect to send (e.g., full PHI vs pseudonymized tokens)?
2) Desired retention window for prompts/outputs and debug logs (30/90/365 days, or other).
3) Residency requirement (US-only, specific region like us-east-1).
4) Any contractual requirements (e.g., audit logs retained for X years, KMS in customer account).

Next steps on our side: I attached a short Redwood_PII_Handling_Summary.pdf that outlines default behavior and options. I'll loop in Neha from Security for a short formal confirmation of the specifics you requested.

If you prefer, we can convert this to a one-page statement-of-facts for procurement/legal to sign off.

Thanks, talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_PII_Handling_Summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <trivers@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PII handling confirmation for prompts/outputs - Acme Health

Hi Marissa, thanks for the recap and for the summary doc. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data scope: we will be sending patient names, MRNs, and brief visit notes that may contain limited PHI. We are not sending full medical records or imaging.
2) Retention: Our procurement/security teams prefer a default of 30 days for any stored prompts/outputs. Debug logs (meta logs) can be kept longer (up to 365 days) if they are pseudonymized.
3) Residency: Must reside in US-only, preferably us-east-1.
4) Logging: We require that any persistent logs that include PII be either masked or accessible only to authorized security personnel, with KMS-backed encryption.

Can you provide a formal statement that: a) confirms Redwood will not retain prompts/outputs beyond 30 days on the Hosted plan unless we opt-in for analytics, and b) confirms the residency and KMS options available (including Dedicated/Private alternatives)?

If you can send that statement and any SOC2 or encryption docs, that'll help us move procurement.

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Patel
Head of Integrations, Acme Health
sana.patel@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PII handling confirmation for prompts/outputs - Acme Health

Thanks Sana, exactly the level of detail we needed. Neha / Rishi, looping you both in to provide a short formal confirmation for procurement/security. Below I sketched the likely options so procurement has something to review while Neha validates: 

High-level options (for discussion / formal confirmation from Security):
- Hosted API (standard): inference is executed in our hosted runtime. Prompts/outputs are transient for inference; we retain diagnostic debug logs by default for 30 days. Customers can request longer debug log retention or opt-out of analytics storage. Residency: we offer region controls (US/EU) for enterprise customers; must confirm us-east-1 availability for this account.
- Dedicated: per-customer GPU pools. Data-at-rest is isolated to the dedicated environment; retention policies are configurable by the customer (30/90/365). KMS integration supported for key management in some plans.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full customer-managed environment; retention and residency controlled by the customer.

Sana, do you want a concise one-paragraph statement we can put on company letterhead for procurement, or a slightly longer technical note (1-2 pages)? We can provide both. Attaching our SOC2 executive summary as a baseline for the security team.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2027-Executive-Summary.pdf (PDF, 450KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PII handling confirmation for prompts/outputs - Acme Health

Hi Sana, thanks, and great questions. Below is a short formal confirmation of Redwood's current behaviors and available options for prompts/outputs, logging, and residency. This is intended as a statement of factual product capabilities; contractual terms can be added to an MSA/SoW as needed.

1) What is stored?
- Hosted API: Prompts and outputs are used transiently for inference. By default, we retain minimal diagnostic logs (request metadata, anonymized error traces) for 30 days to support troubleshooting. Full prompt/output retention for Hosted is not turned on by default and requires explicit customer opt-in for analytics/quality purposes.
- Dedicated/Private: Customers can elect to retain prompts/outputs in their dedicated environment. Retention windows are configurable (30/90/365 days) and governed by the customer's configuration.

2) Where is it stored (residency)?
- Hosted: We offer region selection for enterprise customers (US, EU). For Acme Health we can scope the environment to US-only and aim for deployment in us-east-1; I will confirm final availability with infra and include the region in the formal statement.
- Dedicated/Private: Data resides in the customer-controlled environment or dedicated pool and can be constrained to specific cloud regions as requested.

3) How long is it retained?
- Default: diagnostic logs retained 30 days.
- Optional: Customers can request 90 or 365-day retention for debug logs and/or full prompt/output retention if required (subject to plan and contractual terms).

4) Logging controls and masking
- We support PII masking at the application layer (rule-based) and can redact tokens from logs on ingestion.
- KMS: We support KMS-backed encryption for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted customers we support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) options on enterprise plans where feasible.

5) Auditability and compliance
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant (see attached executive summary). We provide audit logs for access and configuration changes; retention period for audit logs can be negotiated.

Next steps:
- I will confirm availability of a us-east-1 scoped Hosted environment for Acme and whether BYOK can be enabled for your desired onboarding date.
- Marissa/Rishi: I recommend a short (15-20 min) call with Acme Security to walk through the technical note and capture any procurement-language items they need in the statement-of-facts.

Sana, happy to produce a one-paragraph company statement for procurement and a separate 1-2 page technical note for your security team. Which do you prefer?

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: DataRetentionOptions.csv (CSV, 3KB)
